title: Goat's cheese toasts with clementines and walnuts

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Goat's cheese, bread, walnuts, honey, oil, thyme and clementines are all ordinary home foods with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Soft goat's cheese, walnuts and clementines are all everyday Tesco items, especially at Christmas.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, grater and bowl, and the techniques are simple.

works.reason: Four slices halved with 150g cheese and four clementines makes a sensible snack for four, and the zest comes off before the peeling, as it should.

honest_times.reason: Ten minutes covers zesting, beating the cheese and peeling and slicing four clementines, and 2 minutes a side matches the 5 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, and the names match their ids.

seasonal_feel.reason: Clementines on Christmas Eve suit the date, and with four of them plus the zest they are the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholemeal toast with cheese, fruit and nuts is a proper, appealing snack and not mostly sugar.
